submission.justification:
Absorber-F1 gave the best 100 GeV electron resolution at every thickness I tested, with the best point at 5.5 mm (2.94%). The 2025 summary also ranked F1 best at 5 mm (3.2% vs 3.9% for F2 and 5.1% for F3). Scan results for F1: 2 mm 3.53%, 3 mm 3.44%, 4 mm 3.27%, 4.5 mm 3.12%, 5 mm 3.21%, 5.5 mm 2.94%, 6 mm 3.15%, 8 mm 3.77%. The curve is not perfectly smooth, so the run-to-run spread (about 0.1-0.2%) is comparable to the differences between neighboring points. The optimum lies roughly in the 4.5-6 mm range, and 5.5 mm is the best observed point. Only the 5.5 mm point was run for F1 and the scan has not been repeated, so its precise location is uncertain. F2 and F3 were not preferred at any thickness tested. Plate thickness is within the 2-10 mm limit. Mechanical support was reviewed as compatible with all candidates, and readout and cooling are common to all options. The maintenance requirement is not addressed by any project document. Nothing in the documents covers activation or hands-on access for any absorber, so this constraint is unverified for F1 and should be checked before final selection.</justification>
